### New features

Rotate selected pixels to an arbitrary angle with Apply and Cancel controls. Hold Ctrl to sample a colour temporarily, or press E to toggle between Eraser and the previous tool. Temporary sampling can be changed to Alt or disabled in Preferences > Keybinds. Colour alpha is also shown in the brush toolbar.

### Editing improvements

Cropped images stay in place through Undo and Redo, with layer masks following the crop. Repeated selection rotations preserve the selected pixels, rotations that would clip them are prevented, and Enter applies Straighten.

Resize confirmation uses the displayed dimensions. Eraser supports its own modifier-drag resizing, and ending a brush stroke avoids another paint deposit.

Related to issues 224, 237, 238, 239 and 240.

### Interface and Linux

Palette headers follow the swatch grid as the panel resizes. Layer thumbnails use image proportions and transparency. Save As previews follow the image shape without checkerboard padding.

Docked toolbar opacity is adjustable without moving the canvas. Linux uses a safer font loading path, and desktop startup notifications are disabled to avoid the lingering busy cursor.

Related to issues 223, 236 and 241.
